title: ci: checkout submodules in all workflows to catch lockfile drift
body:
PR #635 ran `pnpm install` without the hotcrm submodule, silently stripping all 16 hotcrm package importers from `pnpm-lock.yaml`. CI passed (the workspace glob matched nothing), but Vercel failed because it checks out submodules.

### Changes

- Add `submodules: true` to `actions/checkout` in all workflow files that run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`: ci.yml, lint.yml, performance-budget.yml, shadcn-check.yml, storybook-deploy.yml, storybook-tests.yml, dependabot-auto-merge.yml, changeset-release.yml, release.yml, changelog.yml

This makes CI consistent with Vercel — both environments resolve the full workspace including `examples/hotcrm/packages/*`, so a corrupted lockfile will fail CI instead of silently passing.

```yaml
# Before
- uses: actions/checkout@v6

# After
- uses: actions/checkout@v6
  with:
    submodules: true
```

The lockfile on `main` is already correct. PR #635 needs a rebase to pick up the intact importers.
